intro.label: Membership
intro.tagline: A trusted community for men who want real conversation, not more noise.
intro.title: Find the membership that fits.
intro.description: Read and keep private notes for free. Get verified for free to post, join conversations, and track your fitness. Premium adds longer posts, video, private groups, Marv, and recovery insights. Premium+ includes Premium and helps support the community. Verification is required before either paid subscription.

metaDescription: Compare Men of Hunger memberships: free reading, free verified participation and fitness, Premium at $25/month, and Premium+ at $75/month. Planned benefits are labeled.

tiers.name: Unverified
tiers.subtitle: Free, logged in
tiers.who: Men who want to look around before getting verified.

can.text: Read public posts, profiles, and articles
Follow accounts and bookmark posts
Keep Only Me notes private
Set up your name, bio, and profile photo

cannot.text: Publish public posts, reply, boost, or vote in polls
Start chats or calls, join groups or Crews, or participate in Spaces
Use bookmark collections or Fitness before verification
Buy Premium or Premium+ before verification

why: Explore the community before joining the conversation.
highlights: Follow, bookmark, and keep private notes

tiers.name: Verified
tiers.subtitle: Free, identity-verified
tiers.who: Men ready to participate with a verified identity. No subscription required.

can.text: Everything Unverified can do
Post and reply in public and verified-only conversations, up to 500 characters; boost, repost, quote, and vote in polls
Attach images and GIFs, create polls, and edit posts up to 3 times within 30 minutes
Organize bookmarks into collections
Start direct or group chats with mutual followers; respond to incoming conversations, send photos and voice notes, and use reactions and read receipts
Make voice and video calls in eligible chats, with up to 4 participants
Join open groups, request access to private groups, and join a Crew by invitation
Host or join Spaces on the web, with live chat, shared radio, and synchronized YouTube watch parties
Check in, build a streak, earn coins, and send coins to other verified members
Publish 1 article per day on the web, with public or verified-only visibility; read articles and comments natively on iOS
Track fitness, workouts, steps, weight, and goals; connect Apple Health through the iOS app
Keep fitness data private and choose whether to share an activity or progress post, and with whom
Invite friends and track referral rewards on the web

cannot.text: Publish video posts, video messages, or a video avatar
Start a new chat with a non-mutual member
Create groups, schedule posts, or publish Premium-only content
Use Marv or Premium sleep and HRV summaries
Use Dialogues or other benefits labeled Planned before they launch

why: Full community participation starts with identity, not a payment.
Daily check-ins, conversations, and basic fitness remain available for free.
highlights: Fitness and Apple Health on iOS

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.subtitle: Member
tiers.who: Verified men who want more ways to create, connect, and track their progress.

can.text: Everything Verified can do
Write posts and replies up to 1000 characters and publish Premium-only content
Publish articles without the free daily publishing cap; article writing and editing are on the web
Start chats with any verified member, subject to blocks and message requests
Upload video posts and video messages, and set a video avatar
Create open or private groups, manage invitations, and approve join requests
Schedule posts and manage your publishing queue on web and iOS
Use Marv in supported threads and chats, plus personal catch-up tools with your permission; usage draws from your Marv credit allowance
See sleep and HRV summaries alongside your fitness activity when connected data is available
Invite friends and track eligible subscription rewards in Billing
Structured Dialogues
Monthly facilitated conversations and accountability programs
Small group cohorts, workshops, and organized live calls

cannot.text: Bypass verification, blocks, audience restrictions, or moderation
Buy guaranteed reach or a paid advertising placement
Use planned Steward-only services before they launch

why: Subscriptions fund the product and its operation.
Pay for additional tools and access; the community rules still apply.
tiers.priceNote: Monthly web price. The App Store shows its local price before purchase.

tiers.name: Premium+
tiers.subtitle: Steward
tiers.who: Verified members who want to support the community at a higher level.

can.text: Everything Premium can do today
Premium+ avatar glow and supporter identity
Extra weight in people recommendations under the current ranking rules; placement and reach are not guaranteed
Stewards-only forum, quarterly Steward calls, and monthly written founder updates
Early access to selected new features
Additional feed defaults and advanced mute / filter controls
Additional longform reading and writing tools
Higher media limits, more saved drafts, and an extended edit window
Priority support, moderation review, and account recovery — with the same rules and outcomes
Higher group member caps and event / RSVP tools

cannot.text: Use benefits labeled Planned before they launch
Buy guaranteed reach or a paid advertising placement
Override moderation, other members’ privacy, or product decisions

why: Support the continued operation and development of Men of Hunger.
Premium+ includes Premium, supporter styling, and the recommendation weight described above. The additional Steward services are still planned.

footerNote: Verification is free and required before purchasing Premium or Premium+. Web subscriptions are managed in Billing; Apple subscriptions are managed through Apple. Planned benefits are not available yet. Membership does not buy guaranteed reach; current feed and people recommendations use membership weights. Marv has a separate credit allowance. Feature access can differ between web and iOS.
